stage: ANTIPODAL FACE CERTIFICATE / continuous robust dimension, stage 1
lane: Claude (owner-authorized continuation of the robust-dimension question)
normalization: unchanged: input SD sqrt(3/32), frozen parameter-group RMS, q=ones/sqrt(n), beta=max(1,||R||F), future preactivations [1/4,3/4]^n
query_margins: independent: reviewed support-aware 7/8-gate Cauchy-Schwarz margin; dense: accepted finite-frame dual. No 47/50 gate in the primary result.
domain: raw history within +/-1 of the frozen center (accepted local patch)

screening.proxy: float64 mirror of reviewed kernel with per-axis amplitudes; reproduces the reviewed 4D chart exactly
screening.projection: metric dual of the basis image directions (c^2-weighted for independent, frame-Gram for dense)
screening.optimizer: Nelder-Mead on log amplitudes (r tangent + 1 hidden), 6 restarts, maximize min_i beta_i/epsilon
screening.batches: prefixes 4-10 (224 jobs) then 2-3 (64 jobs), both completed before this freeze; 288 outputs in screening/

candidate_rule: every screening output with proxy min beta/epsilon >= 1.0, plus the reviewed 4D chart as control
rationalization: B and L dyadic 2^-128 (as reviewed setup); amplitudes rounded DOWN to multiples of 2^-20
certified_rule: all beta_i > epsilon at 192 bits AND at 256 bits with the 192-bit rational K/K_h frozen
stop: after stage-1 certification and report; no new histories, widths, architectures, training or epsilon change
